reason: Owner decisions 2026-09-23 (one mod loader, ModContextManager everywhere) and 2026-09-24 (one loading path: every file loads through the VFS by one model, no duplicated functionality). The MK2 sc2-mod operation content.resolve-dependencies was adapted as a codec operation whose result the host turned into mounts; it is superseded by the game's mod loader, which every host (VS Code, LSP, MCP, map preview) reaches through ContentSources.openModContext. A mod, map, campaign or replay subject opens as a context whose layers are the resolved dependency chain in load order, with declared-but-missing packages reported as unresolved. Parity with MK2 was reached before (reports/parity/sc2-mod-content/receipt.json stays as evidence); a comparison with MK2 is not rerun once parity holds.
